flagged.item: OLBG's default tips page surfaces only one eligible-sport event.
flagged.detail: On the snapshot the default page listed football, Gaelic football, horse racing, handball and snooker alongside a single eligible NBA event (MIL @ WAS). No complete eligible-sport OLBG inventory could be reconstructed from that page, so league schedules are used as the fixture inventory and OLBG links are attached only where an event page was actually found.

flagged.item: NHL gamecenter headers and the NHL statistics API disagree with the standings table on games played.
flagged.detail: Carolina's gamecenter shows 7-2-1 while the standings table shows 8-2-1 over 11 games; the gamecenter's own GF/GP of 3.82 equals 42/11, so the rates match the standings while the header does not. The NHL statistics API returns 10 games played and 36 goals for Carolina. All three are NHL.com properties. The build uses the standings table, which is timestamped and internally consistent.

flagged.item: Every NBA line is a baseline; no current-season form exists.
flagged.detail: NBA.com's standings show the 2026-27 season is 0-1 games old, so the engine rates every club league-average and applies a 2.5-point home edge. No total is originated because no verified league scoring baseline is loaded. These are opening-style lines, not informed prices, and every NBA pick is labelled low confidence.

flagged.item: NHL.com standings and the NHL stats API report different goals for and against for the same clubs.
flagged.detail: The standings table counts the shootout-deciding goal; the stats API's goalsFor/goalsAgainst does not. Ottawa are shown with 24 goals for on nhl.com/standings and 22 in the stats API, both over 9 games, and Ottawa have two shootout wins. Buffalo are shown with 34 goals against on standings and 33 in the API, with one shootout loss. The desk's model uses the standings view, so clubs with shootout games carry a slightly higher scoring rate than the API implies. Both figures are official; the gap is definitional and reaches 2 goals, about 0.2 per game, in this snapshot. Independently re-derived from the official game-centre payloads on 2026-10-21 by session db99ed90, which captured the same 14 NHL fixtures separately.
